scripts.check: pnpm run check:frontend && pnpm run check:rust && pnpm run check:bindings
scripts.check:frontend: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check:bindings: cargo run --locked -p wonderland-kernel --example generate_core_bindings --features bindings -- --check && cargo run --locked -p wonderland-plugin-protocol --example generate_bindings --features bindings -- --check
